g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 30-minute benefit, but also promises a voucher without saying what it is for or its value before the ad. That leaves part of the promised reward unspecified.

g_no_cash.reason: The adds, offer copy, and flow promise a voucher as an extra reward. A voucher is a cash-like reward under this gate.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger event uses an article-open counter and a return to the home feed, not anything the reader wrote or said.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The reward temporarily hides sponsored cards; the decline path preserves the feed, articles, saving, and sharing. It does not remove or cap a free reading feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a dismissible banner under the category pills on the content-safe s01 home feed, not inside a conversation or beside unsafe or unknown-rated content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: The 30-minute break from sponsored cards is tied to the observed read-a-story flow f01. But the additional voucher in adds is a new resource with no observed tie to either core flow and is not a slice of a paid benefit.

c2_evidence.reason: The cited screens support the presence of sponsored cards, but not the claims that they are cheap or low-value or that every reader is free. The model says only that no paywall, limit, or currency was seen on the home feed.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The proposed ad-free reading benefit lasts 30 minutes and is capped at two uses per day, so it does not give away an unlimited subscription benefit.

c5_moment.reason: The banner appears after the reader returns from an article, rather than interrupting the article mid-read.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The main benefit follows a confirmed game play, but the flow also grants a voucher for watching a second ad. That extra reward is conditioned on something other than the verified play.

c7_specific.reason: The proposal names the s01 home feed, its category-pill placement, and sponsored cards observed on s01, s06, and s02.
